state.note: Same observed state projection as the latest fixed-grip z model; no task/cube/episode identifiers as inputs.

metrics.mask: Stored cube_moving: observed pre-action linear speed > 0.01 m/s.
metrics.one_step_mse: Mean squared normalized delta error, pooled over all moving rows and 51 coordinates.
metrics.r2: 1 - total SSE / total SST for the same normalized deltas; center each target coordinate over selected rows. Variance-weighted multioutput R2. Zero SST -> null.
metrics.rollout_10_mse: Terminal error mean(((predicted state t+10 - observed state t+10) / train delta_sd)^2), all 51 coordinates. Moving starts with 10 remaining same-episode transitions only. Recorded actions, predicted future states, no clipping or observed future history.
metrics.aggregation: Within each seed pool eligible rows by task and overall; across seeds report arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1). Overall pools rows, not task means.
metrics.unavailable: An empty moving subset is null with count 0. Never substitute nonmoving samples.
metrics.nonfinite: Stop on nonfinite predictions; never discard divergent rows.

normalization.fit: Training episodes only; shared split and same statistics across models/seeds.
normalization.oracle: Mass/friction mean and SD fitted on training rows only; only B2 loads these labels.

training.early_stopping: All rows in 2 held-out episodes per train cube/task, same split as z model.
training.loss: Normalized delta MSE, all training rows; no z, no latent table, no weight decay.

history.sequence: Last K completed same-episode transitions, oldest first, right pad and mask; no current next_state.
history.reset: Empty at every episode start, including eval episodes; never carries context episodes.
history.rollout: Append predicted transitions and retain last K after each prediction.
history.early_late: Literal recorded step 0..4 versus step >=5; moving subset only.

adaptation.design: Cross all 5 B0 seeds with all 5 orders, independently for each learning rate (50 trajectories).
adaptation.optimizer: Fresh Adam at each cube; carry every learned weight between cubes. Fixed normalization buffers.
adaptation.fit_rows: All rows of the current test cube context lifts, episodes 0..4. Sample batches with replacement.
adaptation.scoring: Current cube eval lifts after its adaptation; first cube at each k; full train validation before and after final cube.

protocol.run_gate: Run and report measured B0 seed 0 runtime and metrics before any other model or adaptation run; stop and report failed or suspicious runs.

training.normalization: Training-episode population moments only; float64 accumulation.

subset_metadata.history_scope: Completed transitions within the same cube/task/episode; selection does not remove history rows
subset_metadata.aggregation: Pooled rows and 51 outputs; R2 uses per-feature centered normalized-delta targets
subset_metadata.nonfinite_policy: Any nonfinite included prediction makes its group metric null; counts remain visible

adaptation.aggregation: Pool eligible current-cube rows within each trajectory. Average the five orders within each B0 seed, then report mean and sample SD (ddof=1) across B0 seeds. Orders are not counted as independent trained models.
adaptation.order_variability: Each metric also retains its within-seed sample SD across orders and every seed/order value.
adaptation.retention: k counts further cubes after adapting to the first cube. k=0 is immediately after its own adaptation.
adaptation.differences: Signed after-minus-before values; positive MSE changes and negative R2 changes indicate degradation.
adaptation.normalization: B0 training normalization buffers remain fixed throughout every trajectory.
adaptation.early_window: Literal first five steps have no moving rows; unavailable early metrics remain null in the full reports.

note: No fabricated or extrapolated results. First-five-step moving-only errors are undefined (zero moving rows). SD is sample SD across seeds.

history_availability.definition: On the fixed-grip test evaluation episodes (IDs5..9), score stored pre-action cube_moving rows. At zero-based step t exactly min(t,K) completed same-episode transitions are available; history is incomplete iff t<K.
history_availability.interpretation: These are input-availability counts, not evidence that the model forms a useful belief. Later error changes can reflect task phase even after history is full.
history_availability.step_numbering: Zero-based stored step; plotted human step is stored step+1.
